l-plate.d: a square plate bearing the letter L that is attached to both ends of a car to indicate that the driver is a learner

l-shaped.d: shaped in the form of the letter L

l-p.d: a long-playing phonograph record; designed to be played at 33.3 rpm

l.d: a metric unit of capacity, formerly defined as the volume of one kilogram of pure water under standard conditions; now equal to 1,000 cubic centimeters (or approximately 1.75 pints)

l-dopa.d: the levorotatory form of dopa (trade names Bendopa and Brocadopa and Larodopa); as a drug it is used to treat Parkinson's disease
